title: eludite.navigation.highlight_references output
description: The document's highlighted references, in document order. An edit clears them.

state.description: `loading`: waiting for the language server; `done`: `highlights` is current; `none`: nothing to highlight at the position; `off`: `editor.highlightReferences` is off or the document's server does not offer highlights; `failed`: the request failed.

end_column.description: 1-based column just past the range's end.

kind.description: `text` (a textual match or a keyword), `read` or `write`, as the language server reports them. Read and text ranges are filled with the theme's `reference_highlight_read`, write ranges with `reference_highlight_write`.

current.description: The range (0-based in `highlights`) the caret is in, if any.
